priorityList: Use Rebuke to interrupt spellcasting as needed.
Cast Execution Sentence when Wake of Ashes is ready to be used within the next global cooldown.
Cast Avenging Wrath on cooldown, ideally when Expurgation is ticking on the target.
Use Wake of Ashes if Avenging Wrath is active or will be ready in less than 6 seconds.
Cast Hammer of Light as your primary finisher when available, especially if the proc is about to expire or Avenging Wrath is ending.
Use Divine Toll on cooldown, ideally synced with Avenging Wrath.
At 5 Holy Power, spend on Templar's Verdict (or Divine Storm if Empyrean Power is active).
Cast Blade of Justice if Art of War or Righteous Cause procs.
Cast Hammer of Wrath on cooldown if Walk into Light is talented.
Spend remaining Holy Power on Templar's Verdict (or Divine Storm if Empyrean Power is active).
Cast Blade of Justice on cooldown to generate Holy Power.
Cast Hammer of Wrath on cooldown.
Use Templar Strike, Templar Slash, or Crusader Strike as filler to generate Holy Power.
Use racial abilities (like Fireblood) and combat potions during Avenging Wrath.
